summary: Implemented the Tabs widget feature without running tests or repository code. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with keyboard handling, first-character search, digit activation, click actions via @click metadata, and a watcher animating the bar position); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges (before width) and returns one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style, preserving meta; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (with __init__.py). The layout resolver needed no change because its Edge protocol already has min_size. Deviations and limits: bar position uses the displayed-tab index rather than the full-list index, which only differs for duplicate names; Right/Left navigation can stick on duplicate names because it walks the full list; an empty label becomes a one-cell flexible edge; the sandbox demo was skipped. Nothing was committed.
